description:
A detailed feature specification document for "Project Nexus: Advanced Bookmark Extension" (AI Studio prompt):

**Project Overview:** This document defines the technical and user interaction requirements for "Project Nexus," a feature-rich bookmark management and new tab replacement extension. It streamlines workflows by incorporating automated summaries, user-approved updates, dynamic content feeds, editable cheat sheets, and customizable UI modes.

**Key Functionalities:**

1.  **Smart Bookmarking & Summarization:**
    *   Automatic website summaries and synopsis generation upon bookmarking.
    *   Daily user consent requested for automated actions.

2.  **Engagement & Updates:**
    *   Daily notifications for relevant bookmark-related changes (blog posts, social media events, price fluctuations, GitHub updates, job listings, auctions, etc.).
    *   Dynamic summary of top ten bookmarked sites.
    *   Weekly breakdown with related media (TV shows, music, movies) and content links.

3.  **Homepage Interface (New Tab Page):**
    *   **Main Title Bar:**
        *   Clock (centered).
        *   Date & Temperature (left, text-only).
        *   Hamburger Options Menu (leftmost).
        *   **Dynamic Right Menu Dropdown ('Toggle Page'):**
            *   Displays active options: "Normal View" (active), "**Focus Mode (Cheat Sheet)**", "**Alternate View (Second Page)**", and a new "Customization" option.
            *   Provides user login/account management, sharing features, bookmark import tools, incognito mode access, and other utility features.
        *   Toggle Switch (between clock and right menu, same size as hamburger).
        *   Music Player.
        *   Search Bar.
    *   **Navigation & Layout (Normal View):**
        *   Horizontal category list (e.g., Food, Tech, Art).
        *   **Left-Side (60%):** Vertical, drop-down category boxes. Each box displays the title, optional description, and listed bookmarks (similar to image_1.png style but with description lines as shown in image_2.png).
        *   **Right-Side (40%):** 'Notifications' box and an 'RSS Feed / News' box below it, with icons.
    *   **Navigation & Layout (Alternate View / Second Page):**
        *   Accessible via 'Toggle Page' menu.
        *   Uses large, highly customizable icons or favicons for selected bookmarks.
        *   Allows integration/embedding of widgets (calendars, post-it notes, recommended feeds).
        *   Maintains the Main Title Bar and Hamburger Menu. Right menu now lists "Normal View" as an option.

4.  **Content Feeds & Media:**
    *   Dynamic top RSS feeds and podcasts list based on bookmarks (editable).
    *   Automated or semi-automated RSS/Podcast subscription options (user approved).
    *   Articles readable aloud or accompanied by soft background music.
    *   Editable playback times and feeds.

5.  **Interactive Cheat Sheets (Focus Mode):**
    *   Accessible via 'Toggle Page' menu.
    *   Wipes Normal View content (bookmarks, notifications, RSS) and applies selected cheat sheet as wallpaper.
    *   Title bar and menus persist.
    *   Wipes current wallpaper; first-time access shows a cheat sheet selection modal (which disappears after selection).
    *   **Specific Cheat Sheet Controls:** Two prominent icons where categories used to be:
        *   "Switch Cheat Sheet" icon.
        *   "Overlay Normal View" toggle icon.

6.  **Customization:**
    *   Extensive styling controls for both Normal and Alternate Views (wallpapers, colors, icons, fonts).
    *   Visibility toggle for icons and bookmarks.
    *   User can set extension as new tab page/homepage.
    *   Widgets: PDFs, newspapers, tech sites, tutorial courses, social media, calendars, reminders, custom articles.

**User Interaction Flows:**
*   **Bookmarking:** Click browser extension icon -> Prompt to approve summary and add description -> Summary visible on New Tab page.
*   **Changing Views:** Click 'Toggle Page' menu -> Select a view (e.g., "Alternate View").
*   **Enabling Focus Mode:** Click 'Toggle Page' menu -> Select "Focus Mode" -> Selection modal appears -> Select a sheet -> Mode activates with wallpaper and new control icons.

**Technical Requirements:**
*   Browser permission management for summaries and data scraping.
*   Database for user data, bookmarks, summaries, notifications, feeds, and cheat sheets.
*   User synchronization and cloud storage.
*   Integration with external APIs (weather, summarization engines, social media feeds, GitHub, RSS parsing).
*   Front-end development focusing on clean, minimal UI and smooth transitions.
*   Support for offline mode where applicable.

**Visualizing the UI:**
*   Refer to the minimal aesthetic of image_0.png and image_2.png as the baseline style.
*   Ensure all defined UI elements are present and correctly positioned according to user specifications.
*   Clearly depict all active menus, buttons, and interaction options.
*   Show the relationship between the Normal View, the Alternate View, and the Focus Mode (Cheat Sheet).
*   Explicitly show the move of the side-icons from image_1.png into the new right dropdown menu.
*   Ensure that category boxes are vertical lists (not blocks) and display descriptions.
*   Clearly name 'Focus Mode (Cheat Sheet)' and 'Alternate View (Second Page)' options in the menus, and name the dropdown menu button 'Toggle Page'.
